summary: The agent built a complex multi-sheet Excel workbook with 90 members, 78 named ranges, and cross-sheet formulas. However, the task failed verification. Key gaps: (1) No test file was read at the start - the agent assumed requirements based on source data rather than parsing actual test assertions, (2) No pytest was run during construction - only custom verification was used, (3) The agent never saw the actual test failure details. The skill needs stronger emphasis on mandatory test-first parsing and iterative pytest validation.
